_note: Index members as published, refreshed by hand after each quarterly review with tools/refresh_index_members.py. Today's members only: not point-in-time, so never use this for a backtest or a performance claim (it would be survivorship-biased; model review M9). Index names are trademarks of their owners. Each index has its provider's review calendar ("review"); an index whose members were checked before its latest review (plus 30 days) is stale and hidden, and so is one whose members match the universe poorly (uvalu/indices.py). Members are matched by company: ticker, other lines of the company, then name or an "aka" name.
